article.summary_es: Center for Family Life es una despensa de alimentos en Brooklyn, aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad. Atiende de martes a jueves de 1pm a 4pm.
article.summary_en: Center for Family Life is a food pantry in Brooklyn, listed on the City's Food Help NYC map. It is open Tuesday through Thursday, 1pm to 4pm.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
Está ubicada en 443 39th St, Brooklyn, NY 11232.
La despensa atiende de martes a jueves de 1pm a 4pm.
Puede llamar al (929) 480-7175 para preguntar antes de ir.
La lista no indica qué alimentos entrega ni si hay requisitos; pregunte directamente.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 443 39th St, Brooklyn, NY 11232.
The pantry is open Tuesday through Thursday, 1pm to 4pm.
You can call (929) 480-7175 to ask questions before visiting.
The listing does not say what food is given or if there are requirements; ask directly.
